title: Bounded receive slice 2: Windows OpenSSH duplex protocol-v2 receive into an admitted spool
outcome: Bounded receive slice 2: Windows OpenSSH duplex protocol-v2 receive into an admitted spool
acceptance: Receive uses the shared admitted duplex OpenSSH launch from the SSH transport work, strict protocol v2, exact ref and pinned commit; not GIT_SSH under ordinary git fetch
Every decrypted Git-protocol byte read (advertisements, framing, sidebands) consumes pre-reserved credit; no limit+1 detection read; parser and diagnostic buffers are separately bounded
HTTPS, macOS and Linux refuse before connection, credential or network work, without changing an existing remote to SSH
A complete-looking pack followed by SSH failure or unknown child/pipe result is a refusal or pending state, never Ready
